notes: Original unchanged GLBs and their external colormap texture. Runtime removes the authored static truck wheel nodes and renders the original wheel-truck GLB at actual independent physics wheel positions. No upstream Rigs of Rods code or art is used.

nature.notes: Unchanged existing licensed project copies retained at their previous paths; additional sample copies only.

runtime_details: Source GLBs remain unchanged. Runtime clones omit static source wheels and apply chassis axis scaling to the 1.76 m track and 2.9 m wheelbase; windows, bronze markings, workshop architecture and matching bridge planks are added scene meshes. Four separate wheel models follow engine contact telemetry. Original PNG atlas quadrants are sampled into runtime materials; source images stay unchanged.
